titulo_es: A fixed expression · nuances, record and idiomatisms

texto: A word changes strength according to the record and the context. Compare «måske», «sandsynligvis» and «vist»; learn complete placement and avoid translating particles in isolation.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.es: Por eso el cambio no fue una sorpresa.
